textHelp.title: MAPHEADER
textHelp.paragraph1: The mapheader plugin adds a top strip above the viewer with configurable HTML content: institutional logos, title, subtitles and links, typical of download portals or corporate maps.
textHelp.screenshot1Alt: Map without institutional header strip; standard viewer controls visible
textHelp.screenshot1Description: Example with the header collapsed: the map reaches the top edge and the action to show it again is available.
textHelp.screenshot2Alt: Same viewer with dark blue header, logos, centred title and button to hide the header
textHelp.screenshot2Description: With the header expanded, configured elements (branding, title, texts) appear. Use “Hide” to return to map-only view.
